attributes.title: AMCP 2027
attributes.summary:
AMCP 2027, the annual meeting of the Academy of Managed Care Pharmacy, runs April 13 to 16, 2027, at Moscone West in San Francisco. The audience is managed care pharmacy: pharmacists and leaders at health plans and PBMs, biopharmaceutical companies, integrated delivery networks, consultants, actuaries and researchers. AMCP expects more than 4,000 attendees.

The program centers on coverage, cost and formulary decisions, real-world evidence, precision medicine and population health, and AMCP says attendees earn CE. The number of CE hours, ACPE details and registration fees have not been published yet. AMCP members save up to $400 on registration, and booking in the AMCP hotel block gives a further $100 off (student members excluded).
